snippet.title: The Last Caretaker - Update 04: Below Us Trailer
snippet.description:
Content Update 4 is Live
The ocean is opening further.

Content Update 4 adds new places to reach, new tools to use, new traces of the past to uncover, and another large round of fixes and performance work.
Take to the air with the Salvage Gyro. Find Gyro Service Towers. Enter Eden Cradle and uncover its questline. Step closer to Project Canticle.

▶ Play/update now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1783560/The_Last_Caretaker/
▶ Full patch notes: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1783560/discussions/0/844005830910046317/
▶ Join Discord: https://discord.com/invite/channel37

What’s in Content Update 4
Salvage Gyro: A new light utility aircraft for reaching high platforms, deep pits, service towers, and places your boat cannot take you.
Gyro Service Towers: New high platform locations with Salvage Gyro blueprints, repair documentation, tools, parts, and field-service equipment.
Eden Cradle: A new maze-like Seed Vault with separated chambers and deeper links to humanity’s survival systems.

Project Canticle: A new area connected to the deeper mystery of the world.
HoloMemory: Visual traces of past events now appear in selected world locations. Not just decoration. Pieces of what happened before.
New tools: Decoy Pod, Drone Charging Station, and Hook Cables.
World updates: New Silo locations, improved weather, ambience, lighting, environmental effects, reverb, PECO hums, enemy cues, and soundscapes.
F.E.L.I.S. and PECO updates:  F.E.L.I.S. is cheaper and more customizable. PECO terminals, UI, cartridges, minigames, text, screens, and music playback have been improved.

Under the hood: Content Update 4 also includes a major technical pass across CPU, GPU, physics, vehicles, world streaming, loading, save import/export, localization, UI, audio, collisions, drones, quests, inventory, interactions, and stability.

Big systems matter. Small things matter too.
Content Update 4 is live now. Continue the directive. Save humanity.

For more news and updates, subscribe to our YouTube and Twitch channels for weekly developer livestreams, and follow us on X, Bluesky, and Instagram.
